summary: Configure explicit passwordless root launch for the graphical desktop assistant
changes: Added root-owned graphical launchers and a narrowly named passwordless sudo command for the desktop user. Updated system and user desktop entries. Root uses a separate profile and D-Bus session. Electron sandbox is disabled for the explicitly requested root execution. Existing desktop profile and credentials were not copied. No service or job was changed.
tests: Sudoers validation, launcher syntax checks, both desktop-file validations and passwordless launch check passed. Real launch produced eleven root-owned graphical processes. Interactive account login and window contents were not verified.
rollback: Private backups and an executable restore script restore desktop entries and remove the new launchers and sudoers permission. Close the root application separately; its profile is retained.
problem: The regular graphical launcher executed as the desktop user, while the requested behavior was to run the whole graphical application as root without authentication prompts.
solution: Use a specific root-owned sudo launcher and a dedicated root graphical profile.
reproduction: Launch the configured desktop entry and verify the main graphical process has effective user ID zero.
